name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-roast-my-work-habits-prompt
title: Roast My Work Habits
shortDescription: Get a funny, kind, work-appropriate roast of your work habits using Microsoft 365 Copilot and available Work IQ context.
longDescription: Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot for a lighthearted roast of your work habits. With work grounding, available Work IQ context can personalize the response within your access permissions. The prompt keeps the humor funny, kind, and work-appropriate; review the result before sharing.
